sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish

feed.title: Federal appeals court affirms Enbridge's Line 5 pipeline is trespassing on Bad River reservation land, grants company more time to reroute
feed.summary: A U.S. Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals ruling upheld a lower court's finding that Enbridge Energy's Line 5 pipeline is trespassing on the Bad River Band of Lake Superior Chippewa reservation. While confirming the trespass, the appeals court reversed the 2023 deadline for pipeline removal, instructing the lower court to balance tribal and public interests for a "reasonable" reroute window. The decision also dismissed the public-nuisance claim and ordered a recalculation of the $5.15 million restitution.
